summary.text: Shannon Bray is the Libertarian nominee for the open U.S. Senate seat. A U.S. Navy veteran who works in information technology and software development, he says he is known in the cryptography and blockchain fields. He has run statewide as a Libertarian before: for U.S. Senate in 2020 and 2022 and for lieutenant governor in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Born in Marrero, Louisiana; graduated from Thibodaux High School and served in the U.S. Navy from 1991 to 1997.
Earned an associate degree from Arapahoe Community College (2014), a bachelor's degree from Colorado State University (2016), and a graduate degree from the University of Delaware (2018).

Professional experience includes information technology, software development, information security, and management; he has been associated with the Coast Guard Auxiliary, the Naval Sea Cadet Corps and the Navy League.
Describes himself in a Ballotpedia survey as an author, speaker and professional coach living in Apex, North Carolina, with his wife and three children.

Was the Libertarian candidate for U.S. Senate in 2020 (3.1%) and 2022 (1.4%), and for lieutenant governor in 2024 (1.9%); he advanced to the 2026 general election without a Libertarian primary contest.
